review_mode: independent read-only source and supplied compile log; no builds or source edits
checks: Reach existentially chooses one operation list, with both numeric bounds and Allowed over that very list and actual ReachesOps over the same endpoints; list choice is outside forall fuel.
Reach.trans concatenates actual runs in chronological order, adds actual operation lengths and SSTORE weights, and preserves Allowed. mono only weakens bounds.
singleton derives the opcode from actual one-step Reaches and decodeAt equality; singleton_result preserves the exact selected gas/e witness and endpoint function.
chain/chainAt/liftAt retain the exact intermediate state and actual returned gas/e/activeWords; no new poststate or desired trace is assumed.

block_step obtains the annotated trace from xRuns_symBlock_ops using actual checked sites, symBlock result, gas/stack gates and code/PC bindings; static Allowed/store counts apply to exactly those sites.
Allowed explicitly excludes LOG0 and CALLDATACOPY in addition to pinned opcode union membership. storeWeight counts actual SSTORE occurrences, not changed storage slots.
scope_limits: Generic local budget algebra, not reference replay/resource adequacy or whole-system liveness.
Halt is outside Reach; a consumer must account for its actual terminal operation separately.
